네.e: 예 is a slightly more formal 'yes'.
네.t: 네? with a rising tone means 'Sorry? / Pardon?'. Also used just to show you're listening.

오.forms: Sino-Korean · dates, money, minutes, phone numbers, floors (오 분, 오월)

밤.e: 밤 'chestnut' is said with a longer vowel.

영국.x: It rains often in the UK.
영국.e: 영 comes from an old sound-spelling of 'England'.

자전거.x: On weekends I ride my bike by the river.

빌리다.x: I borrowed an umbrella from a friend.
빌리다.t: 빌리다 = borrow; 빌려주다 = lend. 펜 좀 빌려주세요 'Could you lend me a pen?'

제주도.x: Jeju is an island with a beautiful sea and Hallasan Mountain.

배터리.ex: 배터리가 얼마 안 남아서 충전해야 해요.
배터리.x: My battery is almost dead, so I need to charge it.
배터리.t: Say 배터리가 없어요 or 배터리가 다 됐어요 when your phone is dead.

양식.ex: 오늘은 한식 말고 양식을 먹고 싶어요.
양식.x: Today I want Western food instead of Korean food.
양식.e: Literally 'ocean food' — food from across the ocean, meaning the West.
양식.t: Homonym warning: 양식 also means 'form, format' in documents.

양식.x: This building was built in the Gothic style.
양식.t: Watch the homonyms: 양식 can also mean Western food, food supplies, or fish farming.

잠그다.forms: 잠가요 · 잠갔어요 · 잠글 거예요 · 잠그세요 (ㅡ drops)
잠그다.m: to lock; to turn off (a faucet)
잠그다.x: Be sure to lock the door when you leave.
잠그다.t: Correct form is 잠가요; 잠궈요 is a very common mistake, even among natives.

자기소개서.x: Writing a personal statement is really hard.
자기소개서.t: Often shortened to 자소서 in casual speech.

특징.ex: 이 음식의 특징은 맵고 달다는 거예요.
특징.x: What's special about this dish is that it's spicy and sweet.
특징.t: Pronounced [특찡]; common pattern: N의 특징은 -다는 것이에요 'the feature of N is that…'.

자랑스럽다.x: I'm really proud of my daughter.
자랑스럽다.t: 자랑스럽다 is pride in someone or something; 뿌듯하다 is the warm glow after your own achievement.

알리다.m: to inform, to let (someone) know, to announce
알리다.ex: 시간이 정해지면 저에게 꼭 알려 주세요.
알리다.x: Please be sure to let me know once the time is set.
알리다.e: Causative of 알다 'to know' — literally 'make someone know'.

향상.ex: 꾸준한 연습은 실력 향상에 도움이 돼요.
향상.x: Steady practice helps you improve your skills.
향상.e: Literally 'toward up' — moving upward, getting better.

도저히.m: (not) at all, (not) possibly, no matter what
도저히.ex: 이 문제는 너무 어려워서 도저히 못 풀겠어요.
도저히.x: This problem is so hard I just can't solve it.
도저히.e: Literally 'reaching the bottom' — tried everything, still impossible.
도저히.t: Almost always paired with a negative like 못, 안, or 없다.

공정하다.ex: 경기에서 심판은 항상 공정하게 판단해야 합니다.
공정하다.x: In a game, the referee must always judge fairly.

가해자.ex: 경찰은 사고를 내고 도망간 가해자를 찾고 있습니다.
가해자.x: The police are looking for the driver who caused the accident and fled.
가해자.e: Literally 'person who inflicts harm'; its opposite 피해자 is 'person who suffers harm'.
가해자.t: Used for anyone who causes harm, in accidents, bullying or crime, not only for criminals.

다시 말해.forms: 다시 말해 · 다시 말해서 · 다시 말하면
다시 말해.m: in other words, that is to say
다시 말해.ex: 그는 회사를 그만뒀어요. 다시 말해 지금은 백수예요.
다시 말해.x: He quit his job. In other words, he's unemployed now.
다시 말해.e: Literally 'saying it again': 다시 'again' + 말하다 'to say'.

획득하다.m: to obtain, to win, to acquire
획득하다.x: A Korean athlete won a gold medal at the Olympics.

끌리다.m: to be dragged; to be drawn to, to be attracted
끌리다.ex: 이상하게 그 사람에게 자꾸 마음이 끌려요.
끌리다.x: Strangely, I keep feeling drawn to that person.
끌리다.e: Passive of 끌다 'to pull': literally 'get pulled' toward something.

정작.forms: 정작 + key person/moment: 정작 필요할 때 · 정작 본인은
정작.m: actually, when it really matters, the very (one)
정작.ex: 할 말이 많았는데 정작 만나니까 아무 말도 못 했어요.
정작.x: I had so much to say, but when we actually met, I couldn't say a thing.
정작.e: Native adverb that points to the person, moment or thing that really matters, often against expectations.
정작.t: Close to 막상 'when it comes to it'. It also marks 'the very person': 정작 본인은 괜찮대요 'The person himself says he's fine.'
rel: when it actually comes to it

공화국.x: The Republic of Korea is a democratic republic.
공화국.t: Article 1 of the Korean Constitution begins: 대한민국은 민주공화국이다.

융성.ex: 이 시기에 불교 문화가 크게 융성했습니다.
융성.x: Buddhist culture flourished greatly during this period.

원자재.ex: 원자재 가격이 올라서 제품 가격도 올랐어요.
원자재.x: Raw material prices went up, so product prices rose too.
원자재.e: 원 'original' + 자재 'materials': what goes in before processing.

폭락하다.ex: 농산물 가격이 폭락해서 농민들이 걱정하고 있어요.
폭락하다.x: Farm prices have crashed, so farmers are worried.

엄밀히.x: Strictly speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
엄밀히.t: Almost always in 엄밀히 말하면 or 엄밀히 따지면 'strictly speaking'.

내면화.x: Children naturally internalize their parents' values.
내면화.e: Literally 'becoming part of the inner side'. -화 = -ization: 세계화, 현대화.

징병.ex: 한국은 징병 제도가 있어서 남자들은 군대에 가야 해요.
징병.x: Korea has a conscription system, so men have to serve in the military.

하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다.forms: 하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다고 · 하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다잖아요
하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다.m: heaven helps those who help themselves
하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다.ex: 하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다고, 운만 기다리지 말고 먼저 노력해 봐요.
하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다.x: Heaven helps those who help themselves, so don't just wait for luck; make an effort first.
하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다.e: A translation of the English 'Heaven helps those who help themselves'; 자 (者) is a formal word for 'person'.
하늘은 스스로 돕는 자를 돕는다.t: Pronounced [돔는 자를 돔는다]. Used to encourage effort instead of waiting for luck or help.
nb: 가는 말이 고와야 오는 말이 곱다

유류분.m: legally reserved portion (an heir's forced share)
유류분.ex: 그는 아버지의 유언에도 불구하고 유류분 반환을 청구했습니다.
유류분.x: Despite his father's will, he sued to claim his legally reserved share.
유류분.e: Literally 'portion kept back' — heirs get it even if the will says otherwise.

통상마찰.ex: 두 나라 사이의 통상마찰이 점점 심해지고 있습니다.
통상마찰.x: Trade friction between the two countries is getting worse.

자유시.ex: 요즘 시인들은 형식에 얽매이지 않는 자유시를 많이 써요.
자유시.x: Poets these days write a lot of free verse that isn't bound by form.
자유시.e: Literally 'free poem' — no fixed meter or line length.

바로크.x: Bach is the leading composer of the Baroque period.
바로크.e: From 'Baroque', via French; note the extra vowel: 바-로-크.

탈원전.ex: 탈원전 정책을 두고 찬반 논쟁이 뜨거웠습니다.
탈원전.x: There was a heated debate over the nuclear phase-out policy.
탈원전.e: 탈- = 'escaping from': 탈원전, 탈플라스틱; 원전 is short for 원자력 발전(소).
탈원전.t: Pronounced [타뤈전]: the ㄹ links into the next syllable.
